title: Sr. Corporate Counsel
description:
Overview:

**Sr. Corporate Counsel - Privacy**  
  
**Be Part of One Team, One Purpose.**  
  
At **Emmes Group**, we’re shaping the future of clinical research—**where human intelligence meets cutting-edge technology** to drive meaningful advancements in healthcare. With over **47 years of scientific excellence**, we’ve led groundbreaking research in **cell and gene therapy, vaccines, infectious diseases, ophthalmology, rare diseases, and neuroscience.**  
  
Through our two business units—**Emmes, a full-service CRO**, and **Veridix AI, our technology, data, and analytical solutions** —we are modernizing clinical trials and accelerating the development of life-changing therapies.  
  
We believe that every clinical breakthrough starts with **people**—people who are **passionate, purpose-driven, and ready to make an impact.** At **Emmes Group, we bring People, Science, and Technology together to collaborate with our customers and deliver global health impact.** Our culture is built on **integrity, collaboration, and innovation**, ensuring that every challenge is met with perseverance and accountability.

The Senior Counsel, Privacy, will be based in India and reporting to the Chief Legal Officer. This role supports the Company's global privacy program, advises colleagues across the business on privacy matters, and works closely with the Legal team on the privacy and security aspects of the Company's contracting activity, including data incident management, review of data privacy and security SOPs, and negotiation of Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) and Data Use Agreements (DUAs).

Responsibilities:

* Serves as a key member of the Company's global privacy team, supporting the development, implementation, and ongoing administration of the Company's global privacy program across the jurisdictions in which the Company operates.
* Conducts periodic review and assessment of the Company's data privacy and security standard operating procedures (SOPs) and related policies, and recommends and drafts updates to ensure continued alignment with applicable law (e.g., GDPR, India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, HIPAA, U.S. state privacy laws) and industry best practice.
* Leads and supports data incident management and investigations, including intake, triage, root-cause analysis, remediation, and coordination of any required regulatory or contractual notifications, in partnership with Information Security and other stakeholders.
* Serves as a trusted advisor to colleagues across the Company on day-to-day privacy questions, including data mapping, privacy impact/risk assessments, retention, and cross-border data transfer issues.
* Advises Legal team colleagues on contractual matters relating to data privacy and security, including review and negotiation of privacy and security terms in vendor, sponsor, and clinical trial-related agreements.
* Supports the negotiation, drafting, and review of Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) and Data Use Agreements (DUAs) with sponsors, vendors, sites, and other third parties.
* Monitors legal and regulatory developments affecting global data privacy and security, and advises the Chief Legal Officer and business leadership on their impact to Company operations.
* Assists in developing and delivering privacy training and awareness materials for employees and relevant stakeholders.
* Supports maintenance of the Company's privacy compliance records, including records of processing activities (ROPA), data inventories, and privacy risk registers.
* Collaborates with Information Security, Compliance, HR, and business unit stakeholders on privacy-by-design and other cross-functional privacy initiatives.
* Other duties as assigned by the Chief Legal Officer/Chief Privacy Officer.

Qualifications:

* LL.B./J.D. or equivalent law degree; qualified to practice law in India (or another relevant jurisdiction) and in good standing
* Minimum of 7-10 years of relevant legal experience, with substantial experience in data privacy and security law
* Experience handling data incident management and investigations
* Experience negotiating and drafting Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), Data Use Agreements (DUAs), and related privacy and security contract terms
* Experience advising on privacy matters in a global organization; experience in a contract research organization, life sciences, healthcare, or technology company preferred  
  **KSA**
* Vision and Strategy: Understands the Company's global privacy program and how it supports the Company's broader business and compliance strategy. Helps translate privacy program objectives into practical guidance and support at the operational level within the Legal department and business units. Problem Solving: Demonstrates strong problem-solving and analytical skills, combined with sound judgment, in resolving privacy, data incident, and contractual matters. Oversight: Exercises diligent oversight of assigned privacy matters, data incidents, and DPA/DUA negotiations, escalating to the Chief Legal Officer/Chief Privacy Officer as appropriate. Metrics: Tracks and reports relevant metrics (e.g., data incident response times, DPA/DUA turnaround times, SOP review status) to support the effectiveness of the global privacy program. Culture: Exemplifies Company values in all actions and behavior, and helps promote a culture of privacy and data protection awareness across the organization. Credibility and Integrity: Develops credibility with colleagues and business partners as a knowledgeable and responsive privacy resource; demonstrates impeccable integrity. Continuous Improvement/Change Management: Continually assesses the effectiveness of privacy SOPs, templates, and processes, and recommends improvements as needed. Brings new ideas and practical solutions to drive efficiency and quality for internal stakeholders. Communication: Communicates effectively, and across time zones, with colleagues, the Legal team, and business stakeholders globally. Stays informed of, and communicates, relevant privacy and regulatory developments in a clear and supportive manner.
* Demonstrated proficiency in MS Office suite
* Strong working knowledge of global data privacy and security laws and frameworks (e.g., GDPR, India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, HIPAA, U.S. state privacy laws)
* Attention to detail and strong analytical and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple matters and competing priorities in a fast-paced, global environment
* Strong problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across functions and geographies
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with colleagues at all levels and in different regions/time zones
* Sound judgment and ability to work independently with appropriate escalation

If you’re looking for a career where your work **advances global health** and where **scientific excellence meets real-world impact**, join us and be part of something bigger. **One Team, One Purpose.**  
  
**CONNECT WITH US!**  
*Find us on LinkedIn:/the-emmes-group/*  
Visit our website:https://www.theemmesgroup.com/

title: Assistant Legal Counsel
description:
As Assistant Legal Counsel, you will play a key role in supporting the GSK Legal Contracting Network (LCN) through effective contracting, risk management, litigation support, and operational excellence. You will develop your expertise in Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) tool and processes. You will acquire and develop knowledge of the supply chain business. This role requires strong negotiation skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to foster collaboration across stakeholders.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

***Contract Review and Negotiation***

* Review, draft, and negotiate supply‑chain contracts, including:
* Purchase agreements for active pharmaceuticals ingredients, bioscience materials, devices or packaging;
* Logistics services agreements such as transport, warehousing, customs brokerage, or 3PL services.
* Use approved templates, clause libraries, and playbooks to ensure consistency and speed.
* Ensure all agreements comply with GSK’s policies, regulatory requirements, and risk management standards.
* Provide guidance to stakeholders on contractual matters, ensuring clarity and alignment with the business objectives.
  

***Process & Delivery***

* Manage contract requests through the Contract Lifecycle Management tool / intake system in line with the service level agreement.
* Support high‑volume contracting while maintaining quality and compliance.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of templates, playbooks, and contracting workflows.
  

  

***Risk Management***

* Identify any legal risk associated with the commercial contracts being supported and mitigate the same by referring to Playbooks and leveraging any knowledge and support resources.
* Escalate non-standard issues to your line manager
* Advise the Supply Chain business on any related legal, policy, regulatory requirements applicable to the contracting activities.
  

  

***Claim Management***

* Manage – in coordination with the Procurement function – any claim with the suppliers for the recovery of losses due to a non-compliance with the contract requirements (commercial, compliance, quality or business provisions) or for any other cause of liability.
* Seek guidance from the Legal Dispute Resolution team in the event of escalation of the claim or for an early case assessment in the event of a dispute.
* Maintain accurate records and databases of ongoing or potential litigation matters.
  

  

**Key Qualifications**

  

*Education & Experience*

  

* Bachelor’s degree in law (LLB) or equivalent; a master’s degree (LLM) or relevant certifications (e.g., Bar qualification) is a plus.
* 5 to 10 years of experience in corporate legal operations, contract management and/or litigation support.
* Prior experience working in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is preferred.
  

  

*Technical Skills*

* Good user skills of Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) tools and platforms, with the ability to optimize their usage for operational efficiency.
* Strong legal knowledge of commercial purchasing activities, including drafting and negotiation of agreements.
* Familiarity with litigation processes and procedures.
  

  

*Core Competencies*

* Stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships across a diverse and international team.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
* Excellent communication, both written and verbal, and strong negotiation skills.
* Ability to prioritize, and work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* A proactive mindset with a focus on continuous learning and process improvement
  

**Skills**

Business Acumen, Critical Thinking, Data Privacy, Legal Document Review, Legal Strategies, Negotiation, Risk Mitigation Strategies, Stakeholder Management  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Senior Audit & Compliance Analyst, ITC
description:

Full Time

Career area

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**

  
  

As a Lead in the Audit and Compliance team of the Core ERP Technology function, you will participate in the operation of the overall Audit and Compliance program; Sarbanes Oxley (SOX) and IT Compliance.

For the IT SOX program, you will support and help to improve the IT portion of NIKE’s compliance with the Sarbanes Oxley Act of 2002. You'll be a member of the team that guides and coordinates all other NIKE Tech teams whose year-round performance sustains NIKE’s SOX compliance. You will also be part of a virtual team that links the NIKE Technology organization with the global NIKE Finance Compliance team. You will deliver expert consulting on IT process controls and IT audit readiness. You will partner with external audit teams and with NIKE IT Audit and NIKE IT Infrastructure Security. Primarily focusing on NIKE’s Core ERP systems.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON**

  
  

This role will be performing these key tasks:

* Creation, adoption, and execution of a strategic plan to align SAP Compliance and Audit in accordance with Industry best practices and SOX Compliance.

* Manage Master Service Partner teams to successfully execute large initiatives in addition to smaller ongoing support projects.

* Vendor Relationship - Building strong relationships with a variety of third-party providers to deliver the tools and skills needed to fulfill the application security strategy

* Coordinate and lead system redesign and upgrade/patching activities for the application security team

* Develop and operate application security services relevant for applications

* Work closely with other NIKE teams to help implement and operate security controls
  

**WHO WILL YOU WORK WITH?**

  
  

You will work in close partnership with other leaders throughout NIKE's technical and business community to ensure NIKE ITC embraces industry-leading innovations, trends, and transformations and accelerates and supports business strategies and priorities for NIKE’s rapidly growing business. This position will require that you bring a strong background in in the audit and compliance field and a familiarity of SAP Technologies, combined with the facilitation and influencing skills needed to shape NIKE's future direction. This is a position that will allow you to exercise your leadership, interpersonal, and technical skills. It will be rewarding yet challenging at the same time. This is not "just another job".

  
  

**WHAT YOU BRING**

  
  

* Bachelor's degree in IT, Business, Business Information Management, or a related field

* 5 years' professional experience in IT Application Development, Application Implementation, or Production Support—or—3 years’ professional experience in IT infrastructure security engineering or operations.

* 4 years of IT auditing or other formal internal controls experience, 5 years' additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree

* 3 years of SAP Audit Experience

* Excellent written and verbal communication

* Proven ability to be self-directed and information-seeking and to work effectively in cross-functional teams
  

  

**PREFERRED**

  
  

* Experience with a public accounting firm, audit services firm, or Fortune 500 company is strongly preferred

* Experience in assessing, designing, and implementing application security, IT processes and controls that adhere to documented policies, procedures and standards is a plus

* Experience with IT "best practice" methodologies (e.g., CMMI, COBIT, ITIL) or with IT Security framework ISO-27001 is a plus.

* CISSP, CISA or CISM certifications are preferred.

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete\* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

What You Can Expect

------------------------

Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you.

If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world-class service and what makes you unique.

### **03 Interview**

Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

title: Compliance and Operations Risk Test Specialist (Technology Risk and Controls)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

If you are a detail-oriented professional with a passion for risk management and compliance, join our dynamic team in the Testing Center of Excellence to navigate complex risk landscapes while making a pivotal impact in our firm's risk strategy. As a Compliance and Operations Risk Test Specialist, your understanding of risk management and control evaluation will be instrumental in identifying and mitigating risks to enhance compliance and operational risk management. Your primary focus will be test execution with precision and accountability to ensure seamless delivery of quality outcomes aligned with the firm's highest risks. You will be responsible for assessing the control environment and identifying gaps to mitigate risk. Your analytical thinking and problem-solving skills will help break down complex business objectives into manageable tasks and activities while contributing to a cohesive and efficient testing framework.

**Job summary:**

As a **Compliance and Operations Risk Test Specialist** within the **Testing Center of Excellence**, you will execute testing with precision and accountability to support delivery of quality outcomes aligned with the firm's highest risks. You will assess the control environment, evaluate control design and effectiveness, and identify gaps to mitigate risk and support regulatory requirements. You will collaborate with process and control owners and cross-functional teams to plan walkthroughs, gather evidence, analyze potential issues, and support timely reporting. You will read and interpret policies, standards, and procedures to support accurate implementation of compliance requirements and strengthen control evaluation methodologies, control ratings, and metrics. You will propose and implement improvements to testing methods to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

**Job responsibilities:**

* Understand and evaluate the assigned function's control environment by assessing the adequacy, effectiveness, and design of controls to ensure risks are mitigated, meet regulatory frameworks, align with the firm's risk priorities, and satisfy testing requirements
* Execute testing processes with precision and accountability to assess the control environment, identify gaps, and prepare robust documentation including process documents, process flows, and overview documents that support testing conclusions
* Collaborate with process and control owners and cross-functional teams on the testing schedule, obtain walkthroughs of processes, document process changes, gather evidence, analyze potential issues, and facilitate timely reporting
* Lead walkthroughs and other meetings with business owners, fostering collaboration across engagements with minimal oversight
* Read and interpret policies, standards, and procedures to support accurate implementation of compliance requirements while continuously improving control evaluation methodologies and interpreting control ratings and metrics
* Propose and implement improvements to current testing methods, contributing to the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the firm's risk management

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills :**

* Qualified graduate with minimum of 2 years of work experience in technology and cybersecurity controls testing, audit, or operational risk management within a risk and control environment
* Fair and broad understanding of cybersecurity and technology associated risks
* Fair understanding of areas such as identity and access management, data protection, software development, governance, risk, and compliance, technology resiliency, and networking
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, particularly in analyzing large data sets to identify exceptions or patterns and evaluating situations to identify key information
* Strong ability to build partnerships with key stakeholders and collaborate with business and functional experts to recognize risks and gaps
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to remain flexible and productive through shifting priorities and deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an ability to influence business leaders in a meaningful and actionable manner
* Demonstrated expertise in Microsoft Office applications, with advanced skills in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint highly recommended

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills :**

* ISO 270001 Auditor/CRISC certification desirable
* Audit and control testing background/experience
* Comfortable using intelligent solutions like Alteryx and Tableau to support testing activities or metrics reporting
* Ability to innovate, challenge the status quo, and identify automation opportunities

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

  

Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment through a joint accountability model that aligns managers with each function and region to mitigate operational risk. The team focuses on four areas: Control Design & Expertise, Risks & Controls Identification/Assessment, Issues & Control Deficiencies and Control Governance & Reporting.

title: Senior Compliance Engineer
description:
### **About Hevo**

Hevo is a fully-managed, no-code data pipeline platform that helps organizations move, transform, and activate their data in real time. With 150+ pre-built, battle-tested connectors, Hevo lets data teams focus on insights instead of pipeline maintenance — trusted by 2,000+ organizations globally to keep their data flowing reliably, securely, and in compliance with standards like SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, DORA and HIPAA.

### **About the Role**

As Hevo's enterprise customer base grows, security and compliance reviews are an increasingly visible part of how deals get done. We're looking for a Senior Compliance Engineer to own our GRC program end-to-end — audits, risk, vendor management, and policy — and to be the technical face of security and compliance to customers and prospects during due diligence. Strong communication is essential: this role is regularly customer-facing and needs to translate technical detail into language that builds trust.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own and operate our compliance programs (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, DPDP as applicable) end-to-end — control implementation, evidence collection, and audit management
* Be the primary point of contact for external auditors; manage audit timelines and evidence collection
* Own the risk assessment program — identify, assess, score, track, and report risks via a risk register
* Manage vendor and third-party risk assessments and due diligence
* Respond to customer and prospect security questionnaires (RFPs, due-diligence requests, trust-portal access) with accuracy and speed — a high-visibility, customer-facing part of this role
* Support Sales and Customer Success on security & compliance calls with prospects and customers, translating technical controls into business language
* Draft, maintain, and drive review of security policies and procedures
* Track and report on compliance posture and drift to leadership
* Partner with engineering and security teams to close compliance gaps pragmatically, balancing rigor with velocity
* Use GRC tooling (e.g., Sprinto, Vanta, Drata, or similar) to automate evidence collection and monitoring

### **What We're Looking For — Must-Haves**

* 4+ years in GRC/compliance engineering or related roles (compliance, audit, information security)
* Hands-on experience running SOC 2/ISO 27001 (or similar) audits end-to-end
* Strong understanding of data protection & privacy — GDPR, HIPAA, PII/PHI handling
* Proven ability to manage vendor/third-party risk assessments
* Excellent written and verbal communication — comfortable presenting to and negotiating with external customers, auditors, and executives
* Experience responding to customer security questionnaires / RFPs
* Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS) — enough to assess and discuss controls with engineering
* Strong organizational skills — able to manage multiple audits and timelines independently

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with GRC automation platforms (Sprinto, Vanta, Drata, OneTrust)
* Relevant certifications (CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CIPP)
* Experience in a B2B SaaS company handling enterprise customer data

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Analyst Global Trade Compliance
description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

As **Analyst, Global Trade Compliance** here at **Illumina** , you will support the delivery and continuous improvement of our global trade compliance program.

Working as part of the Global Trade Compliance organisation, you will provide analytical, operational and project support across a broad range of international trade activities.

The role will have exposure to key areas of trade compliance including **tariff classification, country of origin, customs valuation, export controls and sanctions, licensing, import/export operations, customs compliance and trade data analytics** . You will also support global governance, reporting, audit readiness and process improvement initiatives as priorities evolve.

You will collaborate with Global Trade Compliance colleagues across regions and partner with cross-functional teams including **Supply Chain, Logistics, Legal, Tax, Finance, Procurement and other business functions** to support compliant and efficient global trade operations.

As part of Illumina’s global trade compliance organisation, you will contribute to building scalable, data-driven and digitally enabled compliance capabilities while supporting Illumina’s mission to **unlock the power of the genome to improve human health** .

**Why You**
-----------

You are an analytical and curious professional with an interest in international trade and global business operations. You are comfortable working with **data, systems and detailed regulatory information** , while being able to translate findings into clear actions and insights.

You enjoy working across different topics and are comfortable operating in a global environment where priorities may evolve. You bring a structured, proactive approach, strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn and develop across multiple areas of global trade compliance.

**Fluent English is essential.**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Provide analytical and operational support across **global trade compliance programs and priorities**
* Support activities relating to **tariff classification, country of origin, customs valuation, export controls, sanctions and licensing requirements**
* Conduct trade compliance and regulatory research and document findings, recommendations and supporting rationale
* Analyze **customs, trade and compliance data** to identify trends, exceptions, inconsistencies and potential areas of risk or improvement
* Support the development and maintenance of **trade compliance reports, dashboards, KPIs and management information**
* Support global **governance and control activities** , including compliance reviews, control testing, documentation and follow-up of identified actions
* Assist with **audit and regulatory readiness** , including evidence collection, data analysis and maintenance of supporting records
* Support the maintenance and improvement of trade compliance **processes, procedures, guidance and documentation**
* Participate in **process improvement, automation, digitalization and system initiatives** , including data validation and user acceptance testing where required
* Collaborate with regional Trade Compliance teams and cross-functional stakeholders to support global initiatives and resolve trade-related questions
* Support training, knowledge management and other trade compliance awareness activities
* Provide support across other **Global Trade Compliance projects and priorities as business and regulatory needs evolve**

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in **International Trade, Supply Chain, Business, Law, Finance, Economics, Engineering** or a related field
* Approximately **2–5 years of relevant professional experience** in trade compliance, customs, import/export, supply chain, logistics, regulatory compliance, data analytics or a related area
* Understanding of international trade and customs concepts; experience in one or more areas such as **tariff classification, customs valuation, country of origin, export controls, sanctions or licensing** is preferred
* Strong **analytical and problem-solving skills** , with the ability to work with complex datasets and identify patterns, exceptions and root causes
* Strong **Excel** skills; experience with data visualisation and analytics tools is an advantage
* Experience with ERP, customs or global trade management systems; **SAP and SAP GTS experience is preferred**
* Interest in **technology, automation and the use of data to improve compliance processes**
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple activities and priorities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across **functions, cultures and time zones**
* Experience within a **multinational or matrix organization** is an advantage
* Professional trade compliance or customs certifications are a plus

  
We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. title: Applied Scientist II, Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Can a large language model read a regulatory change and draft the requirements and control tests that follow from it, accurately enough for a Compliance Officer to sign off? How do you train a breach-risk model when confirmed breaches are rare, arrive months after the event, and mean different things to Compliance, Assurance, and the regulator? What does a model have to prove before a Compliance team acts on its output?  
  
We are looking for an Applied Scientist to join the Data and Analytics team within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS). Our team builds the data, analytics, and modeling layer that RCS runs on, from regulatory reports and filings to the intelligence that tells Compliance Officers and our first line of defense (1LoD) partners where risk concentrates and which controls hold. You build the machine learning (ML) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) systems in that layer, take them into production, and own the evaluation science that lets Compliance rely on them.  
  
The work spans 3 areas: risk models that score which open risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches; GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage; and the evaluation science behind every model and agent the team ships. Financial crime compliance is the first domain, and its constraints shape the science: threats change faster than control sets adapt, and every output faces internal audit and external examination. Once an approach proves out, you carry it into the next compliance domain across the RCS portfolio.  
  
You own problems from formulation to production: framing the science question with Compliance and 1LoD partners, designing experiments and backtests, building and validating models, and shipping them into the pipelines, reports, and tools that RCS teams use. The stack includes Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Redshift, and AWS Lambda, and your partners include data scientists, data engineers, business intelligence engineers, and software development engineers across RCS.  
  
The successful candidate treats an auditor's question as a design requirement, writes production-quality code alongside their models, and stays comfortable when the evaluation set does not exist until they build it.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Formulate ambiguous compliance problems as ML and GenAI problems with Compliance and 1LoD partners, and choose methods that fit the data, the risk, and the audit standard
* Develop risk models that learn from rare, delayed, and noisy labels to score which risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches, and calibrate them so a score carries a defensible meaning
* Build GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage
* Design the evaluation for every ML and GenAI system you ship: golden sets that compliance experts label, metrics suited to rare outcomes and generated text, and release criteria a system meets before Compliance relies on it
* Deploy and monitor models in production with software development engineers, including drift detection, performance tracking against realized outcomes, and retraining criteria
* Explain model decisions, quantify uncertainty, and document methodology so Compliance Officers, auditors, and examiners can trace how a system reached each output
* Create reusable science components, such as feature sets, scoring services, and evaluation harnesses, so an approach that works in financial crime compliance extends to the next domain without a rebuild
* Review peer models for statistical soundness, mentor data scientists and engineers on ML methods and experimental design, and publish or patent where the work and confidentiality allow

  
About the team  
Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) serves as a crucial safeguard for Amazon's buyers, brands, and selling partners while ensuring business teams meet their regulatory obligations. RCS operates as the second line of defense under the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model, providing specialized oversight, monitoring, and expertise while setting policies and procedures that guide Amazon's compliance framework.  
  
RCS's mission is to apply specialist industry insights and Amazon's unique approach to scale through technology, delighting customers through tailored compliance solutions. Our work spans multiple critical areas, including:  

* Streamlined license acquisition that enables Amazon's financial services expansion
* Management of existing business risks across the organization
* Comprehensive governance, risk, and assurance services
* Innovative solutions such as Compliance as a Service (CaaS)
* A proactive, intelligence-led framework for compliance operations

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience in financial modeling, or experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment
* Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations, or experience with data infrastructures: relational analytic DBMS, Elastic-Search, and Big Data EMR/EC2/Glue/Lambda

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
